tabOrderNote: Order is the order of AddTab calls in OptionsMenu.Initialize: Video, Game, Brightness, Audio, Input, Controller, Live Streaming (Account). Tabs gated by native Show*Options() checks whose results are not in the pak.

bottomActions.note: The Apply/Reset/Back action bar buttons are drawn by the UIManager bottom bar from InputActionDataTable rows, not by OptionsMenu itself.

uiInputActions.keyIndexNote: PlatformSpecificKeys[0..3]: index 0 is the PC/keyboard entry (Escape for GenericBack, Enter for GenericForward); 1-2 are gamepad face buttons (Xbox/PS4 pad); 3 None. The exact platform enum order is not in the pak (inferred).

fonts.note: Menu text uses NotoSans (Regular/Bold, TextStyle-Base* / TextStyle-Button*) for body, labels, tooltips and tabs; headings (TextStyle-Header-*, e.g. "BRIGHTNESS CALIBRATION", dialog/overlay messages) use the Foundation Burbank composite font ("Burbank-Black" = BurbankBigCondensed-Black). A few widgets override with the deprecated /Game/UI/Fonts/Burbank-DEPRECATED object (typeface "Small Medium" = BurbankSmall-Medium, size 12 - OptionsMenu.OverlayText, TabInputOptions.OverlayText). Slate pt size is the style Size; pt->px mapping and kerning are not serialized.
